import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Strip whitespace from text columns
    for col in ['island', 'species', 'sex']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'nan': None})
    # Fix species typo
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix sex case variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace({'FEMALE': 'female'})
    # Convert text-number columns to numeric
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (4850000 likely entered in mg instead of g)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
